title: Refusal
description: The body of a refusal the control plane answers a request of the provisioner contract with, application/json, as the integration contract's refusal, https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/refusal.schema.json. The codes the adapter that serves a node pool meets: first those of that refusal, 401 unauthorized, unsigned and the same whatever the cause, 403 forbidden, which a claim of a pool the adapter does not serve gets, the same as an unknown one, 400 unsupported_contract_version and 400 invalid_request; then 409 no_gateway, a claim whose run's pool choice resolves to no gateway; 409 handed_over, a second handover of a dispatch; 409 not_dispatched, a handover before dispatched; 409 lease_expired, a dispatched or a handover after the lease lapsed, when the dispatch has gone back to the queue; 410 gone, a request of a dispatch that ended because its work item was closed or undone. No refusal is tied to a step or to a policy. A 401 is unsigned; every answer to a verified request is signed. A member this schema does not define is refused.
